listing.name: Sagitarius Concordat
listing.summary: The 1.1 version of the mod is here, it comes with 4 new ship, a new hullmod, balance changes and a description for every large ballistic, enjoy.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with its own ships and weapons, designed for exclusive use.

description:
Welcome to the Concordat, Strafarer.

Welcome to the Sagitarius Concordat — a group of spacers united under the shared belief that every individual stands equal, regardless of their origins or convictions.

This faction is designed to be played exclusively with its own ships and weapons, though you are of course free to do as you please. Fair warning: balancing will be somewhat rough around the edges, so expect things to swing between extremely overpowered and underwhelming. Feel free to share any ideas or suggestions you'd like to see implemented in this thread or on the unofficial discord!

Images of the ships below.

Spoiler

faction particularities

Spoiler
Phoenix Project (not yet implemented): The Concordat has for objective to rule as the domain did on the galaxy before the collapse, witch mean that they need the equipment and industrial power great enough to surpass every other opponent in the sector, thus the phoenix project was born, using pre-collapse blueprints of Domain artifacts Concordats engineers were capable of creating substandards version of those artifacts witch can be bought.

The Uber Program(not yet implemented): In an effort to become the leading military power of the sector the Concordat as developed a special military research program to create upgraded version of there ships, tho they need testing before they can be bought.

Weapon lineage(still in the making): Every weapon of the concordat (will) have a large, medium and small variant, for convinence.

Design synergy: The concordat uses the 3 design in synergy to make for a powerful fleet: low-tech serve as a front line with heavy armor and frontal firepower, midline use there overwhelming firepower to shoot down the ennemies from long distances at the cost of low durability and high-tech is here to fill any gaps in your fleet  thanks to there versatility.
